prompt: Set the tap target sizes for this mobile settings list.
load_bearing: The exact per-platform touch-target floors — 24px WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8, 44pt HIG, 48dp Material 3 — rather than a single rounded 'make it big enough' number.

prompt: Pass this server-fetched data down through several client components in a Next.js app.
load_bearing: The RSC serialization-boundary rule: props crossing server-to-client must be plain serializable data, and identical data should be deduplicated at the fetch layer rather than re-passed down multiple client boundaries.

prompt: Set up Tailwind v4 custom theme tokens in this project.
load_bearing: The @theme namespace and @tailwindcss/postcss configuration trap — tokens declared outside a recognized @theme namespace, or the plugin left unconfigured, silently fail to generate utilities.

prompt: Wire predictive back gesture support into this Compose screen.
load_bearing: PredictiveBackHandler is a standalone composable (androidx.activity.compose) taking a Flow<BackEventCompat>, not a Modifier extension, and the system back-preview animation must not be suppressed.
